sources.title: Family split and byte-count hand calculation
sources.details: Hand calculation: 3 colors × 2 shapes × 2 sides/pitches = 12 distinct families. floor(0.8×12)=9 and floor(0.9×12)=10, so train=9, validation=10−9=1, test=12−10=2. SFT has five templates per family: 45,5,10 records. circle has six ASCII letters, each one byte; adding the single EOS target gives 7 effective targets. 貓 is U+8C93, within RFC 3629's 0x0800–0xFFFF three-byte row and outside surrogate code points, giving three bytes. These are hand calculations; the separately labeled e_cpu execution checks actual generated sizes, target IDs and encoded bytes.

sources.details: For finite logits z_i, p_i=exp(z_i)/sum_j exp(z_j).
